name: FaStart CEO Bot
tagline: One executive voice over your bot crew: a single decision queue, no question asked twice.
description: Rather than juggling separate bots for each function, this one speaks for the whole crew through a single queue for decisions. Ask once and the answer comes back coordinated, so two parts never pull in opposite directions. Unfinished work stays parked on a roadmap instead of quietly going live.
author: enesteve_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
